chapter.heading: The History of Creation
chapter.v:
In the
beginning God created the heavens and the earth. [Ps. 102:25; Is. 40:21; [John 1:1-3; Heb. 1:10] b Gen. 2:4; [Ps. 8:3; 89:11; 90:2]; Is. 44:24; Acts 17:24; Rom. 1:20; [Heb. 1:2; 11:3]; Rev. 4:11]

The earth
was without form, and void; and darkness was on the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the face of the waters. [Jer. 4:23 d [Gen. 6:3]; Job 26:13; Ps. 33:6; 104:30; Is. 40:13, 14]

Then God
said, “Let there be light”; and there was light. [Ps. 33:6, 9 f 2 Cor. 4:6 g [Heb. 11:3]]

And God
saw the light, that it was good; and God divided the light from the darkness.

God called
the light Day, and the darkness He called Night. So the evening and the morning were the first day. [Job 37:18; Ps. 19:2; 33:6; 74:16; 104:20; 136:5; Jer. 10:12]

Then God
said, “Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.” [Job 37:18; Jer. 10:12; 2 Pet. 3:5]

Thus God
made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament; and it was so. [Job 38:8-11; Prov. 8:27-29 k Ps. 148:4]

And God
called the firmament Heaven. So the evening and the morning were the second day.

Then God
said, “Let the waters under the heavens be gathered together into one place, and let the dry land appear”; and it was so. [Job 26:10; Ps. 104:6-9; Prov. 8:29; Jer. 5:22; 2 Pet. 3:5 m Ps. 24:1, 2; 33:7; 95:5]

And God
called the dry land Earth, and the gathering together of the waters He called Seas. And God saw that it was good.

Then God
said, “Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb that yields seed, and the fruit tree that yields fruit according to its kind, whose seed is in itself, on the earth”; and it was so. [Ps. 65:9-13; 104:14; Heb. 6:7 o 2 Sam. 16:1; Luke 6:44]

And the
earth brought forth grass, the herb that yields seed according to its kind, and the tree that yields fruit, whose seed is in itself according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.

So the
evening and the morning were the third day.

and let
them be for lights in the firmament of the heavens to give light on the earth”; and it was so.

Then God
made two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He made the stars also. [Ps. 136:8] [Deut. 17:3; Ps. 8:3 t Deut. 4:19; Job 38:7; Is. 40:26]

God set
them in the firmament of the heavens to give light on the earth, [Gen. 15:5; Jer. 33:20, 25]

and to
rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. And God saw that it was good. [Jer. 31:35]

So the
evening and the morning were the fourth day.

Then God
said, “Let the waters abound with an abundance of living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth across the face of the firmament of the heavens.”

So God
created great sea creatures and every living thing that moves, with which the waters abounded, according to their kind, and every winged bird according to its kind. And God saw that it was good. [Ps. 104:25-28]

And God
blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.” [Gen. 8:17]

So the
evening and the morning were the fifth day.

Then God
said, “Let the earth bring forth the living creature according to its kind: cattle and creeping thing and beast of the earth, each according to its kind”; and it was so.

And God
made the beast of the earth according to its kind, cattle according to its kind, and everything that creeps on the earth according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.

Then God
said, “Let Us make man in Our image, according to Our likeness; let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the air, and over the cattle, over all the earth and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.” [Gen. 9:6; Ps. 100:3; Eccl. 7:29; [Eph. 4:24]; James 3:9 z Gen. 9:2; Ps. 8:6-8]

So God
created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them. [Gen. 5:2; 1 Cor. 11:7 b Matt. 19:4; [Mark 10:6-8]]

Then God
blessed them, and God said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply; fill the earth and subdue it; have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the air, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.” [Gen. 9:1, 7; Lev. 26:9 d 1 Cor. 9:27]

And God
said, “See, I have given you every herb that yields seed which is on the face of all the earth, and every tree whose fruit yields seed; to you it shall be for food. [Gen. 9:3; Ps. 104:14, 15]

Also, to
every beast of the earth, to every bird of the air, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food”; and it was so. [Ps. 145:15 g Job 38:41]

Then God
saw everything that He had made, and indeed it was very good. So the evening and the morning were the sixth day. [[Ps. 104:24; 1 Tim. 4:4]]
